text: Over the last 30 days, visitors have frequently mentioned issues with crowding and timed entry, reporting that the library often feels too busy to fully enjoy the exhibits. Several reviews noted confusion or frustration with the ticketing system, particularly the requirement to purchase tickets online in advance and the inability to pay with cash. Parking has also been a common concern, with some visitors finding it difficult due to large vehicles occupying multiple spaces. While many appreciated the interactive exhibits and architecture, some criticized the heavy use of AI in the displays and the lack of clear directional signage inside. The gift shop received negative comments for its limited selection of library-related items.
